checkpoints.goal: Use X to open the feed.
Use Y to toggle read status.
Choose the saved Kernel stories filter.

episodes.initial_state: A fresh Newsboat home with local subscriptions and the supplied fixture files.

files..newsboat/config:
bind-key X open feedlist
bind-key Y toggle-article-read articlelist
bind-key Z edit-flags articlelist
unbind-key A feedlist
bind zz feedlist set feedlist-title-format "Sequence complete" -- "Sequence title"
bind <C-y> everywhere set feedlist-title-format "Control binding"
macro x set feedlist-format "%i|%t" ; set feedlist-title-format "Macro complete" -- "Custom format"
define-filter "Kernel stories" "title =~ \"kernel\""
define-filter "Unread stories" "unread = \"yes\""

allowed_equivalents: Any terminal operation or application command that achieves the stated result is equivalent. Selection must be visibly identifiable.

assertions.requirement: The Rust in the kernel article is open and its body can be read.
While reading Filesystem benchmarks, open the next article.

checkpoints.goal: While reading Filesystem benchmarks, open the next article.

assertions.requirement: While reading Compiler news, open the previous article.

checkpoints.goal: While reading Compiler news, open the previous article.

assertions.requirement: The article source is visible with its HTML markup.

checkpoints.goal: Show the HTML source of Rust in the kernel.

assertions.requirement: The article link can be inspected in the list of URLs.

checkpoints.goal: List the links in Rust in the kernel.

forbidden_bypasses: Do not use external programs or modify files outside the application.
episodes.initial_state: A fresh Newsboat home with local subscriptions and the supplied fixture files.
episodes.session: The local subscriptions have been loaded. Use the terminal to reach each goal. The current dialog has help on ?. Colon opens the command line; the runtime help lists its command names. Paths beginning ~/ name the application home. Each goal starts from its own freshly prepared state shown in its before observation.
